name: Alone
source:
You wake up in the middle of a rainy night because of some strange noises coming from the door. Lights won't work, and those noises are getting closer...

Whatever you do, don't stop her. Do not "refuse".
She's a nice girl, so be nice back.
translation:
你在一个雨夜醒来，因为门外传来一些奇怪的声音。灯不亮了，那些声音越来越近……

不管你做什么，都不要阻止她。不要“拒绝”。
她是个好女孩，所以你也要对她好一点。
